svg.title: Research-map layers — preserved archive URL state and unavailable/current evidence distinctions
svg.desc: Sol design specification for Egg n Bacon Housing. Proposed interface, repository aggregate values. See accompanying screen-data-map.md for provenance and implementation status.
svg.text: A layer is a claim. Inspect its contract.
Preserve the nine existing layer IDs; do not present archived placeholders as current model evidence.
Predictive training metadata: 1 Jan 2025 · forecast target: 1 Jul 2025, not a forward forecast.

g.text: OUTPUT GATE / NOT VALIDATED FOR CURRENT USE
Archived layer data can be inspected, but current analytical shading is withheld.
Fix uppercase/lowercase area-key joins and validate non-placeholder data first.
Retain selected area and layer IDs in the URL; explain unavailable layers individually.

svg.text: Every legend must name the quantity, unit, period and evidence status.
Spatial: z-score, p-value, LISA class, local Moran I and dimensionless neighborhood multiplier.
Features: MRT sensitivity is S$/sq ft per 100m; school/amenity scores are stored 0–10 indices.
Predictive: six-month projected %, interval fields, target date, training date and model identity.
A source failure disables only its layer. Never fall back to a different quantity or a neutral-looking zero.
Source: analytics/*.json.gz + layer contracts · P: archive gate, truthful legends and normalized geometry joins
